passages.text: Now therefore keep your sorrow to yourself, and bear with a good courage the adversities which have befallen you.
passages.note: bearing grief and adversity with courage

passages.text: You therefore shake off your great heaviness, and put away from you the multitude of sorrows, that the Mighty may be merciful to you again, and the Most High may give you rest, even ease from your travails.
passages.note: setting down heavy sorrow; hope of rest
